marquee.headline: Clear Within lifted its add-to-cart rate 80% with A/B testing.
paragraphs: Paid traffic costs more every quarter. The page it lands on often hasn't changed since launch.

Shogun lets your team build and test landing pages, PDPs, offers and storefront experiences on Shopify without a dev ticket. It then shows what each variant did to conversion, revenue and AOV. It runs as an app inside your existing Shopify store, so nothing gets replatformed.

Clear Within used Shogun A/B Testing to lift add-to-cart rate 80%. Nextbase grew conversions 122% by personalizing content for past customers. Nuun pushed ROAS to 275% with custom Shogun landing pages. The Ridge credits Shogun pages with part of a $2.5M revenue increase.

shoutout.text: You A/B test every ad creative. When did you last test the page it lands on? Shogun lets Shopify teams test landing pages, PDPs, offers and sitewide elements, then see the effect on conversion, revenue and AOV by traffic source. Clear Within lifted its add-to-cart rate 80% this way.

welcome.headline: Shogun: build, test and personalize your store pages
paragraphs: Shogun makes tools for the storefront itself: a visual page builder, A/B testing, personalization and visual merchandising for Shopify and BigCommerce brands.
It is for teams that want to ship campaign pages and PDP changes without waiting on developers, and then know which version actually earned more.

The Ridge credits Shogun pages with part of a $2.5M revenue increase and a 15% conversion lift. GE Appliances uses it to build custom landing pages across multiple sites. Glentel uses it to personalize content by region.
